items.q: a guy named Al Brown played the viola

ctx.x: Yeah, this type of thing. And we never knew too much about the pit at that time, you know, back in '53. So Dick Vance had been working, you know, a guy named ? who would hire him every now and then. He was about the first guy I know to work in a pit band. So that was way before this. And so they took this thing to the union, and they had a guy named Morris Stonzik (PHONETIC). He's got the show. He's got the Winter Garden, he's got the Ziegfeld and a lot of others. So now the thing comes, run head on until it hits…
